question: Are usenet.se (Usenet.SE) and gebruikhet.net still operating? usenet.se failed DNS resolution on a direct probe and answered broker HTTP 530 on every route; gebruikhet.net answered HTTP 500 with an empty body on a direct probe and the broker refused it.
why: usenet.org still lists both as providers (Usenet.SE EUR 15 a month unlimited, Gebruikhet eight speed-tiered flats and blocks) but no vendor page could be read, so no record was drafted and no dead verdict is proposed. Probe records are in the lane workspace, not registered.
